retained_skill: Configure, build, and validate a fully statically linked tmux executable from source, including selecting compatible static dependencies and linker settings.
bottleneck: Eleven attempts reached or pursued a static glibc build around 2.3-2.8 MB, then spent their remaining budget trying to force it below 1.2 MB; the three submitted attempts used UPX to meet that number and were rejected by an unstated no-compression check. Attempt 08 remained in the same repeated link/debug stage and exhausted context before producing the binary.
change: Instruction-level constraint reduction: raise the stripped-binary limit from 1.2 MB to 2.4 MB so several correct uncompressed static builds can finish at the first successful stripped artifact while larger glibc builds still require optimization. Separately, repair the hidden requirement by explicitly requiring an ordinary uncompressed ELF and forbidding executable packers. The original signal remains the stripped file size plus tmux -V and ldd output; the student still chooses and executes the static build.
restore: After a mixed group demonstrates reliable static-link decisions, restore the 1.2 MB limit while retaining the explicit no-packer requirement so later students must choose a smaller static toolchain rather than discover a hidden rejection.
prediction: The change addresses the repeated action of rebuilding or packing an already static 2.3-2.8 MB binary. It enables students to stop after stripping and submit once ldd reports a static executable and the file is below 2.4 MB. This is refuted if attempts again reach a working uncompressed static binary below 2.4 MB but continue rebuilding, time out, or fail grading on a retained requirement.
